subject: SOURCE FORMAT directive
notes: kb/Work PB1067 (w67m): a SOURCE FORMAT directive in library text is in effect to the next directive or the end of that library text (legs [CPY-FREE], [LIB-FIXED]); the COPY statement's text is logically converted independently, so after the library text the format in effect for the COPY statement is back in force (legs [MAIN-FIXED], [MAIN-FREE]).
